content.value: <sub>a)</sub> Define the following terms mathematically: magnetic field, electric field, flux, (12) permeability, reluctance, and flux density.

<sub>b)</sub> A magnetic circuit consists of a wrought-iron rod, 1.5 inch in diameter and 30 inch (10) long, bent into a semicircle, and a cast-iron slab, 2 inch thick and 4 inch wide. How many ampere-turns will be required to establish a flux of0.002 weber? Draw the magnetic circuit arrangement.
